LTCG Tax Abolished in Budget 2027? Is the Government Planning Major Capital Gains Tax Changes?
Will India reduce or abolish Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) Tax? Ahead of Union Budget 2027, fresh discussions around capital gains taxation have raised expectations among stock market investors.
On November 16, 2026, CBDT Chairman Ravi Agrawal confirmed that the government is reviewing proposals submitted by stakeholders regarding changes to the LTCG tax regime. However, no final decision has been announced.
